standard_prerequisites.use: Universal first order thickenings, etale morphisms of algebraic spaces, and topological invariance of the etale site; the construction is retained.

core_obligations: Use topological invariance of the etale site to produce the unique etale morphism between the universal first order thickenings.
Compare the universal properties through the lift to obtain both directions of the statement.

proof_roadmap.step: Produce the unique lift of the etale morphism to the thickenings.
Show the lift is a universal first order thickening for the upper morphism.
Use surjectivity to descend the universal property to the base.

difficulty_reason: For composable morphisms of algebraic spaces with the first etale, the lemma gives two statements: an etale morphism lifts uniquely to a morphism between the universal first order thickenings, and if the lift is etale and surjective then the universal property descends to the base. The proof uses the topological invariance of the etale site to produce the unique lift of the etale morphism, and then compares the universal properties of the two thickenings through that lift. Producing the unique lift via topological invariance is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 3043-3069.
